policy: For each vertex in the existing complementary cover, form complete correspondences between its finite parent-face choice sets. Test existential endpoint relations separately from untruncated paths retaining middle choices. Diagonal identities must be distinguished from complete self-correspondences. Selected facet components keep their facet/parent index.
tests: All composable relation triangles and fourfold associativity cases
Round trips versus diagonal identity at both endpoints
Middle-witness multiplicities even when the endpoint relation is identity
Coherence of selected singleton components with facet retained
Whether those selected components descend to one choice per chart and vertex
boundary: Relation composition forgets middle witnesses; native retained packages do not. No equivalence or parent verdict follows from relational associativity. Failure of a facet-forgetting quotient does not refute the original retained-facet policy.
stop_condition: Exact finite relation/path certificates and concrete parent-change and witness-erasure controls.
